items.en: Ukraine carries out first known aerial casualty evacuation by heavy-lift drone: Heavy Shot Ayudag-6 extracts wounded soldier after 491 days in the grey zone near Kupiansk
items.nl: Oekraïne voert eerste bekende luchtevacuatie van een gewonde uit met een zware drone: Heavy Shot Ayudag-6 haalt soldaat na 491 dagen uit de grijze zone bij Koepjansk
items.sEn: On 4 October 2026 Ukrainian forces evacuated a wounded infantryman from the grey zone on the Kupiansk front by heavy drone. items.en: «CODE 9.2 показав StarGate — новий повітряний дрон для евакуації поранених» (ArmyInform: 'CODE 9.2 shows StarGate, a new aerial drone for evacuating the wounded')
items.nl: Oekraïens 475e aanvalsregiment CODE 9.2 maakt medevac-drone StarGate van SkyFall gereed voor evacuatie van gewonden
items.sEn: Ukraine's 475th Separate Assault Regiment, known as CODE 9.2, is preparing the StarGate heavy drone for casualty evacuation, according to ArmyInform. The regiment published video of its troops readying the heavy multicopter for launch. StarGate was developed by the Ukrainian defence-technology company SkyFall. Accordi…

items.en: «Тяжелые дроны – то, в чем нам нужно наверстывать упущенное» (Dva Mayora: 'Heavy drones — where we need to catch up')

items.en: Ukrainian brigade claims first frontline evacuation of a wounded soldier by heavy hexacopter drone
items.nl: Oekraïense brigade claimt eerste evacuatie van gewonde militair per zware hexacopter-drone
items.sEn: The unmanned ground systems company of Ukraine's 92nd Separate Assault Brigade says it has flown a wounded soldier off the front line with a heavy hexacopter drone, calling it the world's first aerial evacuation of a casualty from the battlefield.
